title: Last Stone Weight: Always Smash the Two Heaviest
summary: A max-heap keeps the heaviest stone at the root, so each round is two pops and maybe one push.

takeaway.summary: When you repeatedly need the largest item, keep the items in a max-heap: the root is the largest, and popping or pushing costs O(log n).
whenToUse: Repeatedly taking the largest (or smallest) item
Items keep changing while you take them

scenes.narration: A pile holds stones weighing 3, 8, 5, 2, and 6. Each turn, smash the two heaviest. Equal stones both break; otherwise the heavier survives with the difference.
scenes.caption: Smash the two heaviest stones until at most one is left

scenes.narration: You could sort the pile every turn to find the two heaviest, but after one smash almost nothing changed, and you'd sort it all again.
scenes.caption: Re-sorting the pile every turn is wasted work

scenes.narration: Instead, keep the stones in a max-heap: every stone is at least as heavy as the ones below it, so the heaviest, 8, sits at the root.
scenes.caption: A max-heap keeps the heaviest stone on top

scenes.narration: Take the 8 off the top. The last stone moves to the root and sinks below heavier stones, so 6 rises to the top.
scenes.caption: Pop 8: the last stone moves up and sinks to its place

scenes.narration: Pop 6 too. Smashing 8 and 6 leaves a stone of 2, which goes back in. It's lighter than its parent, so it stays low.
scenes.caption: 8 smashes 6: a 2 goes back in the pile

scenes.narration: Next round, 5 and 3 come off the top, and their leftover 2 goes back in. Three stones of 2 remain.
scenes.caption: 5 smashes 3: another 2 goes back

scenes.narration: Two stones of 2 come off. They're equal, so both break and nothing goes back.
scenes.caption: 2 against 2: both stones break

scenes.narration: Only one stone is left, weighing 2. That's the answer.
scenes.caption: One stone is left: it weighs 2

scenes.narration: Whenever you need the largest item over and over while items change, a max-heap gives it in O(log n) per pop or push: O(n log n) in all.
scenes.caption: Need the largest again and again? Use a max-heap
